'''Ten Numb''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] pilot who served at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] as part of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] under the callsign [[Blue Five/Legends|Blue Five]].<ref name="SWCE" />

==Biography==
Ten Numb, a former [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and demolitions expert,<ref name="SWCE" /> joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was assigned to [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]]. During the assault on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], Ten Numb was ordered to lead a [[Blue 5|B-wing]] attack against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] command ships. He carried out meritorious service during the battle, and was promoted to [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]] after the conflict, due to the death of [[Merrick Simms]].

[[File:TenNumb-BWingSquadron-TCC.png|thumb|left|250px|Ten Numb with his B-wing starfighter]]
Following the truce at [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], Numb helped combat forest fires on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], using his B-wing's reconfigured weapons systems to spray fire-extinguishing fluid over the canopy.<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Leader">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

He accompanied [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and various members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he was separated from the group when he followed Imperial [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] on a stolen [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]. He was captured by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]], who took him to [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]]. The other Rogue Squadron members [[Mission to Tralus|followed his signal]] but arrived too late to save him, as Ten was killed during interrogation.<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Leader" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rogue_Leader_Nunb.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Numb in the pilot's seat over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]]]
Several creature technicians for ''The Return of the Jedi'' worked on the puppet, including [[Mike Quinn]], who worked on a deleted unscripted scene with Ten Numb in white uniform inside a B-wing cockpit,<ref name="Mike Quinn Interview OT">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsinterviews.com/original-trilogy/mike-quinn-nien-nunb|text=Mike Quinn|work=Star Wars Interviews|author=Pellegrom, Dennis|date=2006|archivedate=20180124195951|nolive=1}}</ref> as well as [[Kirk Thatcher]], who worked on his puppet wearing a red B-wing uniform.<ref name="IGN">Kirk can be seen behind Ten Numb puppet in this article: {{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2000/02/10/interview-with-kirk-thatcher-part-1-of-2|text=Interview with Kirk Thatcher (Part 1 of 2)|author=Plume, Kenneth|date=2000-02-10|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|''IGN'']]|archivedate=20221014220731}}. Please note that the article misidentifies the puppet (wearing the characteristic red B-wing pilot uniform) as Nien Nunb.</ref>

Ten can be seen in the film during the briefing and the celebration on Endor.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|Customizable Card Game]] card<ref name="Decipher">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Ten Numb}}</ref> and both Hasbro action figures depict him in a white uniform.<ref name="hASBRO 1">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=B-wing Fighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjbwing.asp}}</ref><ref name="Hasbro 2">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|text=''Star Wars Evolutions''|pack=Rebel Pilot Legacy (Series 1)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tlcEVORebelPilots1.asp}}</ref> This is based on a preproduction image of the character in which he was wearing a white uniform, not on his film appearance. This is largely attributed to the only known photo of Ten Numb at the time, in the book [[Star Wars Chronicles|''Star Wars: Chronicles'']].<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> Ten also appears in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing: Rogue Leader|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'']] comics wearing a white uniform.<ref name="X-wing RL">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 1|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 1]]</ref>

[[Hasbro]] released a white-uniformed Ten Numb action figure as part of their ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]'' toy line.<ref name="Hasbro 2" />
